column1: # Why it is wired this way (moved from bin/deploy-runtime-install.sh, harbor#1272):
# harbor#6 wired the work-log reconciler at STOP, because its stand-down then read the session context that
# context-resolve.sh (another SessionStart hook, unordered) writes, and on a fresh session that file could be absent.
# harbor#954 removed that dependency: the stand-down reads only the repo's `worklog: off`. So harbor#1390 moves it to
# SessionStart, where it runs once a session instead of every turn: "which sessions never reached Stop" is a
# once-per-session question. It skips the session that is starting, which has a transcript and no record yet.
# A crashed session is now reconciled at the start of the next session rather than at its first Stop.
